0.original: Cahciua wishes to hold a strategy meeting.

25.original: Speak with Cahciua in front of Everkeep.

49.original: Had enough rest, have you? Then let's round up everyone!

50.original: During your confrontation with him, Zoraal Ja bade Wuk Lamat come to the tower's summit.

51.original: Problem is, the elevators have been locked down due to the state of emergency.

52.original: We've been working to lift the access restrictions, but frankly it's not looking promising.

53.original: Are there any other ways we can get to Zoraal Ja?

55.original: As you know, Solution Nine occupies Everkeep's ninth level.

56.original: The summit, meanwhile, is the twelfth.

57.original: The map appears to be cut off.

58.original: While the king and queen's residence is believed to be located there, the details are highly classified. Hence the lack of map data.

59.original: We do, however, have reliable intelligence concerning everything up to the eleventh level.

61.original: That is Origenics, the facility where souls are separated and refined for use.

62.original: The process begins at the base with the extraction of souls from regulators and fiends.

63.original: Those souls are then transported up to the aetheric separator, where they are cleansed of memories.

64.original: Finally, they are packed within soul cells for distribution.

65.original: Twelve forfend... They've recreated the process by which souls are broken down in the aetherial sea...

66.original: An affront to nature, I know, but ethical discussions must wait.

67.original: The salient point is that the facility extends vertically from the first to the eleventh level.

68.original: Now, if Zoraal Ja intends to strengthen himself with the people's souls, as we strongly suspect...

69.original: Then the facility will be operating to process and transport those souls directly to him─on the twelfth level!

70.original: So in order to reach Zoraal Ja, we make our way through Origenics!

72.original: As the facility sustains the Alexandrian way of life, security will be extremely tight.

73.original: But if you are willing to brave the route, we'll back you up as best we can. What say you?

74.original: It goes without saying that we're going!

76.original: I'm coming too. You'll need guidance on-site, and this body makes me best suited.

77.original: ...Hold it. Before you set off, I have to ask.

78.original: All this time, you've known that Sphene is an Endless, haven't you?

81.original: Honestly...it didn't seem relevant to the matters at hand? More complicated to explain than it was worth, and a distraction from our efforts to deal with Zoraal Ja.

82.original: Speaking of which, we should get moving. Those who are sallying forth, we gather in front of the tower!

83.original: We can count on you to provide support from here, yes?

85.original: I need to talk to you about... Never mind. It can wait.

86.original: Lest you wonder, I have no objections to remaining here. Someone needs to keep those in Tuliyollal informed.

88.original: Zoraal Ja is no king. Not anymore. For the sake of Tuliyollal─of the world─we must put an end to his madness.

89.original: I've spoken with Alphinaud. Apparently, the dragons came to Tuliyollal's aid!

90.original: I'm coming too, of course. This is what I've worked so hard to be a part of.

91.original: The summit of Everkeep... Finally, we shall see what the clouds conceal.

92.original: All present and accounted for? Excellent.

93.original: We make for the summit in one push. This will be a grueling climb, so see to it you spare no preparation.
